name: Path Tracing Extension with MIS
definition: A path tracing kernel that extends rays by marching them through sparse voxels, shading intersections using albedo and normal, and generating new ray directions using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) between sun disk and cosine-weighted hemisphere sampling.
summary: Path Tracing Extension with MIS extends path tracing by marching rays through sparse voxels and using Multiple Importance Sampling to combine sun disk and cosine-weighted hemisphere sampling.
